name: Letter to Jin'Zil
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You've done so well for me, adventurer. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ahh, a letter from Darsok. I have not heard from him in many years.

So the last of the Bloodfeathers are dead, eh? That is good news, I can remember when my friend Rokhan went with that crazy mok'nathal to kill her older sister. Ah, to be young again, like you.
narrative.requestItemsText: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 15 to 20, 5,700 XP in all.

quests.name: Harpy Raiders
quests.objectiveText: Collect 8 Witchwing talons. Return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Serena Bloodfeather
quests.objectiveText: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Letter to Jin'Zil
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
